fy_label_note: Baba FY labels equal company fiscal years: WWW uses a 52/53-week year ending the Saturday nearest December 31 (FY2025 ended 2026-01-03). Margin = VA consensus-pivot 'operating_income' / 'revenue' (adjusted basis; actuals through FY2025, FY2026 is consensus). Window is the last five actual years, FY2021 (peak 9.56%) to FY2023 (trough 3.91%). Peer offsets: COLM, CROX and SHOO are calendar years. VFC and DECK FY2021 end in March 2021 and NKE FY2021 ends in May 2021, so their labels lead WWW's calendar by 7 to 9 months. Revenue path includes divestitures (Keds, Wolverine Leathers, Hush Puppies licensing, Sperry, China JV model change).

company.inputs: FY2021 operating income 230.8M on revenue 2,414.9M; FY2023 77.8M on 1,992.1M. FY2024 7.28%, FY2025 9.02% (169.1M / 1,874.3M), FY2026E 9.90%. ltm_margin_pct shows FY2025 actual operating margin; the stage 3 record gives LTM EBITDA margin 10.6% (VA actuals Q2'25 to Q1'26). Pre-window FY2018 and FY2019 were 11.96% and 11.55%.

peers.excluded: Rocky Brands not tracked in Baba. Asian manufacturers and non-US brands in the Footwear comps list were dropped (different end markets or OEM model).

attribution_ratio_note: (14.9926 - 11.5413) x 100 / 565.1905 = 0.6106. On the median of per-peer declines (CROX and SHOO midpoint, 241.26 bps) the ratio is about 0.43. Both fall in the 0.4 to 0.7 band. VFC's margin rose over the window.

management_attribution.quote: Like many other companies in our industry, we continue to experience low demand in our U.S. and European wholesale businesses, which represent approximately 50% of the company's global revenue.
management_attribution.speaker: Mike Stornant, EVP and CFO

management_attribution.quote: In addition to a soft macro environment, our brands have also been negatively impacted by these important factors. Heavy sell-in of end-of-life product earlier in the year, which has created higher promotional pressure in the U.S. market... an ongoing decline in the hike category, and excessive Gray Market selling for Merrell. Vacating an entry price point segment and related distribution for Saucony. Increased price point pressure from private label brands in the work category, temporary lack of product newness, and certain color and trend missteps across the portfolio.
management_attribution.speaker: Mike Stornant, EVP and CFO

management_attribution.quote: Key contributors to the gross margin expansion include approximately $50 million of supply chain transitory costs expensed in 2023 that will not recur in 2024, and approximately $45 million from profit improvement initiatives related to product and logistics costs.
management_attribution.speaker: Mike Stornant, EVP and CFO

deciding_facts: Pattern of missed dated targets: the FY2023 guide of about 8.5% came in at 3.91%, and the 12% for 2024 came in at 7.28%. In 2023 the CFO listed self-inflicted causes (gray-market selling, trend missteps, lack of newness).

WWW fell more than peers and lost ground: 565 bps vs a 345 bps peer median decline (ratio 0.61), with relative position slipping from -544 to -764 bps. The rebound to 9.02% in FY2025 and 9.9% guided in FY2026 came from WWW's own cost and inventory work, while peer margins also eased.
confidence_note: The ratio alone lands in the mixed band (0.43 to 0.61 depending on median method), and part of the FY2023 trough is about $50M of transitory supply-chain costs and divestiture noise. But the missed-target pattern and management's own list of self-inflicted causes are decisive under the rubric.
